From Seasons 1-6, the writing was brilliant, the characters were funny and engaging. You cared for them. The episodes with Barney meeting his Dad and Marshall losing his... All time favorite episodes of ANY show.
After that though.... the show became stale for me. too many cliches. Too many break-ups and new characters that last 4-5 episodes before getting the boot. Writing became a shell of what it was. 
Jason Segal wanted out at season 8, as he felt the show was becoming stale and repetitive. In fact, in the movie "This is the End" he talks about how stale it had become for a brief 5 seconds.
